player_0.content: New plan: My previous attempt failed because I included a "Reasoning" section, which violated the implicit constraint to provide only the answer option (e.g., "A: (B)") as demonstrated in the few-shot examples. The examples showed a strict pattern of "Q: ... Options: ... A: (X)" with no explanatory text. Next time, I will analyze the options to identify the sarcastic statement (the one using irony or hyperbole to mean the opposite of the literal text) but will output **only** the final answer in the format "A: (Option)" without any reasoning, explanation, or extra text.
